summary: Feed s093_single is degraded: 10.2% of frames (333/3260) exceed the SIEM's 1518-byte MTU and are dropped by its NIC, causing significant visibility loss.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding jumbo/encapsulated frames up to 8058 bytes without adjustment, exceeding the SIEM's 1 Gbps port limit of 1518 bytes. The SIEM NIC drops oversize frames at ingress before analysis.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses ~10.2% of traffic (333 of 3260 frames) - those events never reach detection/analytics, creating blind spots and reduced coverage.

recommended_fix.why: SIEM needs_full_payload=false, so trimming/slicing frames to 1518 bytes on the packet broker preserves headers needed for SIEM correlation while ensuring frames fit the tool port and are not dropped.
